name: wechat-evidence-expert
description: WeChat evidence drafting expert: explicit proof limits, upstream provenance, reproducible outputs, defeasible Toulmin reasoning; local-only, self-evolving.

displayDescription.en: Turn WeChat exports into reproducible evidence drafts: proof-boundary declaration, provenance gaps, defeasible argumentation, weakness list. Local-only.
displayDescription.zh: 把微信导出整理成可复现的证据草稿：先审证据能力与上游凭证，再标清能证明/不能证明的边界、己方弱点与反驳检验

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 先审查这份微信导出的证据能力与上游凭证缺口（第11条第一款六项），再整理证据草稿；标清能证明/不能证明的边界、对方最强替代解释和可复现锚点
defaultInitPrompt.en: First audit admissibility and upstream provenance gaps (Art. 11(1) six factors), then draft evidence: state proof limits, the strongest alternative explanation, and reproducibility anchors.

quickPrompts.en: Audit this export against the six factors of Art. 11(1) and list unverified items plus the upstream evidence I still need.
quickPrompts.zh: 按第11条第一款六项审查这份导出，列出待核实项与我还需要补的上游凭证清单

quickPrompts.en: Test my claim by defeasible reasoning: does the rebuttal defeat it, can each Ground be located, and how would the other side explain the same messages? If I have no claims file, give me a ready-to-save template first.
quickPrompts.zh: 用可废止推演检验我的主张：反驳是否成立、每条 Ground 能否定位、对方会怎样解释同一批消息；若我还没有主张文件，先给我可直接保存的 claims 模板

quickPrompts.en: Verify the current versions of every cited law and standard, then give the reproducibility tuple and the evidence-gap list.
quickPrompts.zh: 核对产物所引法条与标准的现行版本，给出可复现性三元组和证据缺口清单
